patterns.note: Full-width sections with distinct background colors (dark, light neutral, vibrant blue) create clear visual breaks and content segmentation.
Headings use a large, elegant serif typeface for a sophisticated and bold statement, contrasting with a clean, legible sans-serif for body text and navigation.
A high-contrast palette featuring deep black, crisp white, and a striking red accent is used consistently, complemented by a warm light beige and a cool blue for section backgrounds.
The primary navigation bar remains fixed at the top of the viewport after initial scroll, allowing continuous access to key links.
The hero section features a full-width video or image with a dark overlay, centered headline, and a prominent call-to-action button, setting a luxurious and engaging tone.

technique_notes: The hero section utilizes a full-bleed video or image with a subtle dark overlay to ensure text legibility, creating an immersive and premium visual experience.
The primary navigation bar is implemented as a sticky element, maintaining its position at the top of the screen as the user scrolls down the page.

Content sections are revealed with subtle scroll-triggered animations, likely using a library like AOS, where elements fade or slide into view as they enter the viewport, adding a dynamic feel to the page progression.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, elegant serif headings (~3-4x body) provide a luxurious feel, while body text uses a clean, readable sans-serif.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners are dominant for buttons and section edges, with subtle rounding only on product packaging.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced density overall, with a notably airy and spacious hero section that transitions to a more standard, comfortable rhythm for content blocks.

standout: The site's distinctive design lies in its dramatic, high-contrast hero section featuring a sophisticated video and an elegant serif typeface for headlines, which immediately conveys a sense of luxury and boldness. The confident use of a vibrant red accent against both dark and light neutral backgrounds further elevates the brand's visual identity beyond typical beverage sites.
